course.title: Cognitive Psychology and the Brain
course.description: This course provides an introduction to cognitive psychology with an emphasis on how mental processes map onto brain function, covering attention, perception, memory systems, language, decision-making, and neuroscience methods such as EEG, fMRI, and lesion studies. Students read primary research literature, design a small original study, and practice communicating cognitive science to non-specialist audiences.
